story.intent: Sales commission calculated and risk committee formed.

body.remarks: Sales commission Q4 FY2027 — Meera: Quota ₹25L, Bookings ₹29L (116%). Calculated ₹1.35L, adjusted to ₹1.18L (one deal 50% credit — founder participated). Manager review complete. Approved for payroll.

body.name: Monthly Risk Committee — FY2027
body.description: CEO, COO, Finance, Engineering, Security, Delivery, HR. Top risks: Cash conversion (High), Logistics project dependency (Medium), Customer concentration (Medium), Cyber credential attacks (Medium), Bench cost (Medium), Vendor dependency (Medium), Hiring freeze impact (Low-Medium).
body.charter: Monthly risk review and treatment tracking. Escalation authority for risks exceeding appetite.

expectedState: Commission ₹1.18L approved for payroll — not paid before approval
Risk committee formed with 7 top risks tracked
notifications: Risk treatment actions assigned to owners
